## Summary

I completed app/ProductGallery.tsx by adding a Next.js Image for each product, following the existing pattern established in app/page.tsx (the hero image example).

Changes made:
- Imported Image from next/image (same import used in page.tsx).
- Replaced the {/ Add product image here /} placeholder with an <Image> component using:
  - src={product.imageUrl} — the per-product image URL from the data.
  - alt={product.name} — accessible alt text derived from the product name, matching the alt="Store hero image" convention.
  - width={300} and height={200} — the requested 300×200 pixel dimensions.
- Kept the key={product.id} on the wrapping <div> and the existing <h4> product name, placing the image above the name.
- Removed the now-stale TODO comments.

Verification: npx tsc --noEmit exited with code 0 (no type errors).

One note: the referenced image files (/product-1.jpg, /product-2.jpg, /product-3.jpg) should exist in the public/ directory for the images to render at runtime — I didn't see a public/ folder in the workspace. If those assets aren't present, the images will 404 at dev/build time; let me know if you'd like me to add placeholder assets or adjust the paths.
